description: Deal Desk pre-trade check: the cards the user gives (outgoing) and gets (incoming), plus cash either way, valued after selling costs → TRADE / COUNTER (with the cash to ask for) / PASS, or NOT_ENOUGH_DATA naming the card without a value (ask the user for its value and pass it as value). Identify each card with search_cards before checking. It is a check: nothing is recorded to the collection. If the result has alerts, show them to the user before anything else.

cashIn.description: Cash the user receives in USD.

cashOut.description: Cash the user pays in USD.

cardId.description: SlabLineage card id from search_cards (any row of the card). Give cardId or the catalog id; one of them is required.

grade.description: The grade on the slab label, e.g. "10" or "9.5". Not needed for RAW.

grader.description: The slab's grading company read off the label: PSA, TAG, CGC, BGS (Beckett), SGC, ACE or another; RAW for an ungraded card.

scrydexCardId.description: Or the card's catalog id, e.g. "sv3pt5-199" (when you have it instead of cardId).

value.description: The user's own value in USD (overrides the price).
